slug: 2025-04-12 Cote d'Ivoire - Registre Social Unique (RSU) operationalisation, 200,000+ households

facts.fact: Cote d'Ivoire is operationalising its Registre Social Unique, a single registry of poor and vulnerable households to be shared with social programmes for targeting, with more than 200,000 households in the process of registration through the SIG-RSU system (BCP Filets Sociaux).

systems.owner: BCP Filets Sociaux, Ministere de la Cohesion Nationale
Ministère de la Solidarité et de la Lutte contre la Pauvreté

note: The story names over thirty programmes as potential users of the RSU and describes no data exchange, link or shared use in operation.

facts.fact: A 7-11 September 2025 workshop at Grand-Bassam, run by the Ministry of National Cohesion through the Filets Sociaux programme office, aims to update the Registre Social Unique's interoperability framework for data sharing between SIG-RSU and CNAM, CNPS, CGRAE, ONECI, WURI and DOB.
